name: english-practices
description: A collection of interactive English educational exercises (Grade 3-7) designed for self-study and classroom use. This project is hosted as a static site on GitHub Pages.

scripts.dev-v2: concurrently "npm run dev -w v2" "npm run dev -w v2-api"
scripts.dev-z: concurrently "npm run dev -w zxt-web" "npm run dev -w zxt-api"
scripts.seed-one: f() { node scripts/seed_practices.cjs "$@" && API_URL=https://epapi.vibequizzing.com node scripts/seed_practices.cjs "$@"; }; f
scripts.deploy-v2: cd v2 && ../node_modules/.bin/vite build && cp public/favicon-prod.ico dist/favicon.ico && ../node_modules/.bin/wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name=english-practices-v2
